rationale: Retain real Windows parser, filesystem, process and delayed tree-termination boundaries. Mocked spawn assertions exercise the shipped routing adapter; real-child suites independently check received arguments and observed process death. All parameter rows and opt-in load setup read.

cases.title: reads the npm node shim MDE flagged (codex.cmd)
cases.reason: Parse a real npm-generated Node shim into its exact relative script target.

cases.title: reads the pnpm two-branch shim, including its NODE_PATH prepend
cases.reason: Parse the real two-branch pnpm shim including the NODE_PATH prepend used by its producer.

cases.title: reads a pnpm branch shim with no NODE_PATH block
cases.reason: Parse an otherwise valid pnpm shim without an optional NODE_PATH block.

cases.title: reads the npm and pnpm shims for a bundled executable
cases.reason: Real npm and pnpm bundled-executable shims resolve to their actual distinct relative targets.

cases.title: refuses %s
cases.reason: The malformed-body table covers bare commands, arbitrary scripts, interpreter flags, disagreeing branches, appended commands, variable targets and empty input.

cases.title: refuses a drive-relative path in %s
cases.reason: Drive-relative script and executable paths are rejected before win32.resolve can change their meaning.

cases.title: refuses %s
cases.reason: Altered argument forwarding is rejected for both first-argument-only and duplicate-all spellings.

cases.title: reads the codex shim through %s
cases.reason: The transport/generator variation table preserves recognition across BOMs, line endings, whitespace, blank lines and casing.

cases.title: refuses lone-CR line endings, which leave the body as one unsplit line
cases.reason: Lone carriage-return bodies are refused instead of being misparsed as ordinary generated lines.

cases.title: refuses a NODE_PATH block whose branches are not a plain prepend
cases.reason: Disagreeing NODE_PATH branch prefixes cannot be substituted with a different environment.

cases.title: resolves the npm node shim to node.exe plus the script
cases.reason: A real temporary shim and script resolve to Node plus the existing script without invented environment changes.

cases.title: prefers a node.exe sitting beside the shim, as the shim itself does
cases.reason: A real sibling node.exe takes precedence over PATH lookup, matching the generator branch.

cases.title: prepends the pnpm NODE_PATH the shim would have set
cases.reason: An actual pnpm shim prepends its NODE_PATH to existing values and handles an absent value.

cases.title: resolves a direct .exe target
cases.reason: An existing direct executable target is returned without an interpreter argument.

cases.title: falls back for %s
cases.reason: The filesystem fallback table covers missing, extensionless, nested-cmd, absolute, drive-relative and unrecognized targets.

cases.title: falls back for a relative program path
cases.reason: A relative program path falls back because resolution cannot assume the child working directory.

cases.title: honours the kill switch
cases.reason: The opt-out environment flag disables a resolution that succeeds without the flag.

cases.title: re-reads a shim whose mtime moved even at an identical size
cases.reason: Changing only mtime on a same-size rewritten shim invalidates the cache and returns the new entrypoint.

cases.title: walks PATH once per shim directory, not once per spawn
cases.reason: Adding an earlier interpreter after the first resolution leaves the cached answer stable, while an actual PATH edit invalidates it.

cases.title: gives up when cmd would resolve `node` to a non-.exe PATHEXT spelling
cases.reason: PATHEXT precedence refuses an earlier node.com instead of silently selecting a later node.exe; changing PATHEXT also invalidates the cache.

cases.title: falls back to cmd.exe when the cached interpreter has been uninstalled
cases.reason: Removing an already cached interpreter causes fallback instead of returning a nonexistent executable.

cases.title: keeps cmd.exe out of the spawn for a recognised shim
cases.reason: The real spawn adapter maps a recognized shim to Node and preserves its arguments at the child_process boundary.

cases.title: clears a caller-set windowsVerbatimArguments on the resolved path
cases.reason: A caller-set verbatim flag is cleared after shim resolution so Node can quote arguments normally.

cases.title: still routes an unrecognised .cmd through cmd.exe
cases.reason: An unrecognized batch command still takes the cmd.exe fallback with the proper verbatim command-line policy.

cases.title: delivers the whole adversarial corpus through the resolved shim
cases.reason: The actual Windows child receives every adversarial corpus value through a recognized real shim, independently of the pure parser.

cases.title: delivers a multi-line agent prompt that cmd.exe could not carry at all
cases.reason: The real resolved spawn preserves a multiline prompt that raw cmd.exe cannot carry.

cases.title: reports the script exit code without a cmd.exe hop in between
cases.reason: A real failing Node script preserves its nonzero exit code through the resolved adapter.

cases.reason: Each actual cmd.exe spawn preserves its adversarial argument with defined environment variables, so percent cases cannot pass accidentally.

cases.title: kills the grandchild when taskkill finishes after the caller stopped waiting
cases.reason: A real delayed taskkill finishes after the caller wait and must still kill the observed live grandchild; its launcher delays only the OS boundary, not the termination receipt.

cases.title: kills the grandchild with the real taskkill on a loaded host
cases.reason: On an explicitly isolated loaded runner, real taskkill must clean up the observed grandchild and report termination despite the caller settling earlier.
